tribunals2422-transfer.1: Peru stated that the Mechanism's fight against impunity relied on states enforcing sentences, executing warrants, and fulfilling assistance requests. Peru urged the Council to remain united behind the Mechanism and actively secure this necessary cooperation.
tribunals2422-transfer.2: Russia explained its abstention, noting that earlier warnings regarding the reappointment of former Yugoslavia Tribunal officials were borne out. It criticized the Mechanism's staffing and administration, specifically questioning the adequacy of Ratko Mladić's medical care. Russia recalled requesting his temporary release to Russia for treatment, contingent upon Russian guarantees, if prison doctors failed to provide adequate care.
tribunals2422-transfer.3: Peru urged the Council to remain united behind the Mechanism, emphasizing that combating impunity depended on states enforcing sentences, carrying out warrants, and answering assistance requests. Russia, citing its earlier warnings about reappointing former Yugoslavia tribunal officials, criticized the Mechanism's staffing and administration. It questioned the adequacy of Ratko Mladić's medical care, recalling its request for temporary release to Russia for treatment if prison doctors failed to provide it, under Russian guarantees.
tribunals2422-transfer.4: Serbia complained that the Mechanism refused Ratko Mladić's temporary release for medical treatment, despite guarantees from the Serbian Government. Serbia stated it was meeting its cooperation obligations and remained committed to prosecuting war crimes regardless of the perpetrators' nationality.
